findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/run/candidate.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The 'Still to do' list counts files, not work, so it can overstate how much is done.
findings.evidence: planned_paths (run/mod.rs:1093) returns only paths. A file the producer half-edited counts as changed, so the note can say 'every planned file has a change' when the work in those files is unfinished. closing.plans.last() also holds the plan's steps, which the plan does not use. Fix: Label the list for what it is ('planned files not yet touched'). Never write 'every planned file has a change' as if nothing is left. Optionally add the plan's step titles, which are short, so the retry sees what the plan still needed beyond file names.
findings.location: Decision 5 / step 3 ('Still to do' = planned_paths minus changed paths)

findings.summary: In the criterion-2 test, only the kept-directory assertion tells the commit seed from the base behavior.
findings.evidence: At the base, seen[0].0 is already true: the existing retrying_a_timed_out_job_starts_from_the_kept_work_with_the_note (lifecycle.rs:2285-2329) passes because the kept directory seeds the work tree. So 'file present' alone does not show the retry starts from the candidate commit. Fix: Put the reason in the test: assert that repo/kept/<first job> is absent before the retry runs, and that the earlier file is still present in the retry's workdir. Optionally also assert that the retry's candidate.json change list holds src/partial.rs.
findings.location: Demonstration for criterion 2, 'Fails without the behavior'

findings.summary: A timed-out closing with a candidate would record no changed paths.
findings.evidence: candidate_stage sets closing.happened.changed_paths (candidate.rs:102-105). keep_timed_out_work replaces closing.happened with self.failure(...) (mod.rs:688), and the plan keeps the changed_paths assignment in candidate_stage only. Fix: After self.failure(...) in keep_timed_out_work, set closing.happened.changed_paths from the helper's change list (or have the helper return it).

findings.summary: The RunContext and timeout-seed doc comments become stale.
findings.evidence: seed_commit is documented as 'The rejected candidate commit ... for a tree-seeded retry', and resume as 'whose kept work tree seeds the producer's working directory'. After the change, both are wrong for a timed-out retry. Fix: Update these doc comments, and those of timeout_seed and keep_timed_out_work, alongside the state.rs comment changes.

findings.summary: Open question 4 is already answered by the existing code.
findings.evidence: candidate_stage already writes blobs with hash_object_w and builds the commit before admit runs (candidate.rs:80, 109-130), so a candidate that admission refuses already leaves objects in the user's repository. Fix: Resolve the question in the decision record: the exposure is the same as for an admission-refused candidate today.
findings.location: Open question 4 (unadmitted content in git objects)

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot and its claims hold. keep_timed_out_work (run/mod.rs:642) moves the work tree and writes progress-note.md but builds no commit. timeout_seed (mod.rs:603) seeds only from the kept directory. producer_snapshot (producer.rs:88) already prefers ctx.seed_commit through BaseThenTree. close.rs:58-72 copies closing.candidate's commit into the outcome. tree_retry_seed requires a verification record, so a timed-out job with a candidate will not be picked up by the rejected-candidate retry path by accident. Writing no resume mark is right: resume_candidate skips the producer, and work cut off at the deadline still needs one. Moving S4 of candidate_stage into a shared helper fixes the fault in the one deadline path, without copying code. That justifies the change to candidate.rs, which Athena flagged as outside the deliverables. Each demonstration uses real seams: Athena::go and Athena::retry through the lifecycle Fixture, deadline_script, record_at, git show_file and check_history. Each would fail at the base on the new assertions: candidate.json with a commit, the short commit in the reason and note, the kept directory absent, and the brief's earlier job id and still-to-do list. CHANGELOG.md is a deliverable on change readings (reading.rs:256-278), so the planned still-to-do assertion on it is sound. No external service is called and no athena.toml field is added. Remaining issues are minor: label the path-only still-to-do list honestly, state in the criterion-2 test why the file's presence proves the commit seed, keep changed_paths on the timed-out closing, and update the stale doc comments.
